chunks: I was among their rear-guard till they turned back on their sides and were flocked in their rope. I never showed weakness or lack of courage, nor did I betray or become languid.
By Allāh, I shall split the wrong till I extract right from its flanks!

key_terms.حَذَافِيرِهَا: entirety or sides (idiomatically: turning back completely)

ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Muhammad describe his perseverance during the early Meccan period?
ai.summary: In this vivid passage from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs the metaphor of a camel to describe the Quraysh's obstinate resistance, asserting that he remained steadfast in guiding them until they were fully entrenched in their disbelief. His vow to 'plow falsehood until truth emerges from its loins' underscores the Shia emphasis on active struggle (*jihād*) against ignorance and the purifying nature of divine truth. This narration highlights the continuity of prophetic leadership and the unwavering resolve required to establish justice amidst societal stagnation.
